nodes.label: Self-Contained Windows Package
nodes.rationale: For portable use the entire ZIP must be extracted to a folder and the EXE must not be run from inside the ZIP or copied alone; the data folder and every DLL must remain beside it. Setup.exe is the recommended install path over the portable ZIP. Supports 64-bit Windows 10 and 11.

nodes.label: platform_ocr package
nodes.rationale: Leverages native OS OCR (Windows.Media.Ocr and Vision.framework) instead of an external dependency like Tesseract for speed and accuracy; keeps processing fully local for privacy and offline support; Android is unsupported because it lacks a built-in OS OCR API.

nodes.label: PlatformOcr API
nodes.rationale: Public Dart API exposing recognizeText() with OcrSource.file and OcrSource.memory inputs so callers never touch native code.

nodes.label: Vision.framework
nodes.rationale: Used on both iOS and macOS via direct Objective-C interop with VNRecognizeTextRequest, supporting path-based and memory-based (NSData) image processing.

nodes.label: ocr_cabi.cpp (C ABI wrapper)
nodes.rationale: Windows implementation uses C++/WinRT behind a C ABI wrapper at src/windows/ocr_cabi.cpp to give Dart a stable native boundary.

nodes.label: Dart Native Assets
nodes.rationale: Used for automated building and linking of native assets, which requires Flutter 3.13+ and the native toolchain installed.

nodes.label: package:image
nodes.rationale: Images are decoded in Dart using package:image to guarantee correct RGBA8 format delivery to the native engine; roadmap proposes moving to Windows Imaging Component (WIC) for native image decoding on Windows.

nodes.label: Quotation Alignment Preview (PDF)
nodes.rationale: Content unreadable by extraction model (PDF input unsupported); filename suggests it previews layout/alignment of a generated quotation.
